title: Foundation Legality
description: Information on deed of establishment, Ministry of Law approval, domicile, and official contacts is provided for easy verification.

title: Annual Report
description: Annual reports contain institutional direction, program achievements, impact stories, collaborations, and learnings from running programs.

title: Financial Report
description: Summary of fund receipts and disbursements is prepared to clarify how public and partner support is used.

title: Program Report
description: Each program can be equipped with targets, activities, outputs, documentation, beneficiaries, and sustainability recommendations.

title: Impact Documentation
description: Activity evidence, beneficiary stories, field updates, and monitoring results are part of impact communication.

title: Professional Partnership
description: For companies, reports can be customized to CSR, ESG, employee giving, or sustainability report needs.
